name: Space Bandits

sources.title: Startups directory — 206 hand-picked space companies, pre-seed to Series B, filterable by industry/country/stage
About — 'If you're building a space startup and want to be listed... email hello@spacebandits.io. It's free, and listings are never pay-to-play'

requirements: Space startups ONLY — sectors include launch, satellites, propulsion, earth observation, in-space manufacturing, space software, etc.
Pre-seed to Series B scope — 'the companies that might become giants'; no defence primes, no space tourism
Free, explicitly 'never pay-to-play' — no placements, stages, or statuses can be bought
Curated: every entry is hand-verified against the public record (see /how-we-verify)
preparation: A genuine space-economy product — a generic SaaS will not be listed
Pitch email: what the company does, sector fit, founding year, HQ country
Publicly verifiable funding/stage info — every figure on the site carries a source link
Optional: founder availability for a written interview (27 published)
workflow: Email hello@spacebandits.io requesting a listing (or an interview)
Provide sector, country, founding year, stage, and source-able funding details
The maintainer (Sarwech Shar) hand-curates — expect verification against public record before the entry goes live
Listed companies get a profile card in the /startups directory; there's a free 'Get the badge' option for founders (/badge)
watchFor: Narrow fit: only space-industry startups — do not pitch a general SaaS
Statuses are honest, not flattering: entries are marked Acquired, Shut down, Dormant, or Graduated from the public record — a status cannot be bought or hidden
Solo-curated since 2019 — turnaround depends on one maintainer
Sponsorships exist but are 'clearly labeled' and separate from listings
countsAsLive: A company card for the startup appears in the /startups directory with sector, country, founding year, and stage
